I’m honored to be endorsed once again by Senator Bernie Sanders as I run to return to Congress to keep fighting for St. Louis’ families.

Bernie knows that for too long, MAGA billionaires and powerful right-wing lobbies have been allowed to rig the economy against everyday people.
